claims.statement: Distinguishability is the minimal ontological condition of determinability.
Information is effective structure of difference.
Causality is the form of efficacy of stabilized relations.
Planck-scale quantities can be interpreted as indicators of limits or boundary conditions of physical determinability.
Spacetime is an emergent order of spatial and temporal differentiation.
Wave-like and matter-like behavior are modes of manifestation within one deeper effective informational order.
Life is a highly ordered self-maintaining stabilization of effective informational organization.
Cognition is increased capacity to select, integrate, evaluate and actionably use information.
Consciousness is reflexive organization of effective informational reality.
The quality of conscious information processing is normatively relevant because conscious action can affect future states.
Ceteris paribus, more life-supporting, less destructive and more reality-tracking successor states are to be preferred.
q.e.d. marks systematic argumentative closure unless a formal proof object is explicitly bound.
